summary.intent: Triage the results of an automated /code-review of the cf51133b..HEAD diff (Rust crate changes around React prop relevance/collapse and the checker merge), fix the valid findings, and commit the review-round changes.
summary.outcome: Findings 1 (dead legacy helpers) and 6 (duplicated default collapse policy, ADR reference) were fixed; findings 2, 3 and 5 were dismissed after checking the code, and finding 4 (perf) was measured as unmeasurable via an A/B release build. Pinning tests were added for visible_rows and the Omit alias (both mutations now fail), the final gate was run, and the changes were committed and pushed.

repo: Review-round changes touch crates/core (react_types.rs, relevance/props_type.rs), crates/semantic/src/lib.rs, and ADR 0022 (ask-a-warm-checker-for-the-requested-component).
The repo has accept.sh and ab.sh scripts for acceptance gating and A/B comparison of base vs. fixed release binaries on fixtures such as Chakra.

Consolidation to a single owner for kept React props uses checker_prop_kept, visible_rows and react_props_wanted_for; the old checker_prop_used, react_prop_listed and react_props_wanted were pub and thus not flagged dead by the compiler.
The project uses mutation proofs (re-running tests against deliberate mutations) to verify new tests actually pin behavior.
Plain rustc resolves to 1.99.1 in this environment, so explicit toolchain overrides are unnecessary.

code.finding: Legacy helpers checker_prop_used, react_prop_listed and react_props_wanted were left as dead pub functions after callers moved to the new helpers; they were deleted.
When cx is None the code hard-coded Dependencies as the default collapse mode, duplicating policy inside expanded; this was fixed to avoid divergence.
The catch-all arm in picks now calls lookup for every named generic type; the perf concern was measured as negligible (flat RSS within ±15 MiB, time within noise, identical output).
Review claimed expanded(entry, cx.mode) with no placement and mode None selects Full; this finding was dismissed after checking the code.

workflow: Triage reviewer findings against actual code before acting, since the reviewer did not build or run tests.
Settle performance-related review concerns with a release-build A/B comparison of time, peak RSS and output identity rather than speculation.
Add tests that pin review-round changes and verify them by re-running each mutation to confirm failure.
Run the full gate on the final tree before committing.

friction: Machine was under heavy load (load average 29), making timing comparisons noisy.
One tool call surfaced as a bash_placeholder, indicating a minor tooling glitch.
Needed to locate the cf51133b base binary and build both base and fixed release binaries for comparison.
open_items: Findings 2, 3 and 5 were dismissed without code changes; details were deferred to the summary rather than recorded in the code.
Finding 4's suggestion to hold the Cow directly or an Arc in Declaration::Alias instead of Box<Cow> was not pursued since no cost was measurable.
